ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Boiling`. A clock does not advance in the tick its region starts, so `t` = 0 although `deltaT` says 1000 ms passed.
One second later. `Boiling` was already active, so the clock advances first: `t` = 1000. Then the transition is tested: 1000 is not ≥ 3000.
`t` = 3000, and the transition sees the new value in the same tick: `ring` = true, the chart moves to `Done` and terminates.
The chart has terminated: nothing changes any more.
